_comment: Example payload generated by site_audit.py. Field keys must match custom fields created in your GoHighLevel sub-account. Not tested against a live GHL account.

customFields.top_issue_1: Problem: Phone number customers can tap to call. Fix: Show your phone number near the top of the page as a tap-to-call link.
customFields.top_issue_2: Problem: Business address search engines can read. Fix: Show your address or service area on the page and add it to LocalBusiness schema.
customFields.top_issue_3: Problem: Business identity for AI tools (name and social profiles). Fix: Add Organization or LocalBusiness schema with your exact business name and sameAs links to your Google Business Profile, Facebook, LinkedIn and Yelp pages.
